about_the_game:
YourFocus is a productivity companion designed specifically for gamers who spend long hours in front of the screen.

It helps you maintain focus, energy, and reaction time during intense gaming sessions by structuring playtime into focus intervals with short recovery breaks. Smart reminders and built-in eye and stretch exercises help prevent fatigue, burnout, and eye strain — so you can perform at your best while gaming.

Compete against yourself with achievements, track your progress, and build lasting healthy gaming habits.

KEY FEATURES:
🎮 Customizable gaming session timers (Pomodoro technique for gamers)
💪 Smart break reminders with eye and stretch exercises
🏆 Steam achievements for maintaining healthy gaming habits
📊 Session statistics and performance tracking
🌍 Multi-language support (English, German, Spanish, French)
💬 Discord Rich Presence integration
☁️ Steam Cloud save synchronization

BENEFITS FOR GAMERS:
⚡ Prevents gaming fatigue and eye strain
⚡ Improves focus, accuracy, and consistency
⚡ Encourages regular breaks and physical activity
⚡ Builds long-term healthy gaming routines

PERFECT FOR:
• Competitive gamers aiming for peak performance
• Streamers playing for long hours
• Esports players preparing for tournaments
• Anyone who wants to game smarter, not harder
